verdict.rationale: Calendly documents round-robin team scheduling and 'meeting distribution tools' on its pricing and scheduling pages, and a community user says they pay for the Teams plan specifically to get Round Robin events. That covers the core of distributing inbound meetings across a team. However, nothing in the evidence shows weighting, priority, or other load-balancing controls that keep the distribution fair, which is half of the story. Missing for 10: documented round-robin weighting or priority settings, evidence of fairness or equal-distribution controls, and in-depth docs or hands-on corroboration of how round-robin assignment behaves.
